title: The container platform must uniquely identify all network-connected nodes before establishing any connection.
check_content:
Review the container platform configuration to determine if the container platform uniquely identifies all nodes before establishing a connection. 

If the container platform is not configured to uniquely identify all nodes before establishing the connection, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the container platform to uniquely identify all nodes before establishing the connection.
VulnDiscussion: A container platform usually consists of multiple nodes. It is important for these nodes to be uniquely identified before a connection is allowed. Without identifying the nodes, unidentified or unknown nodes may be introduced, thereby facilitating malicious activity.
